'''February 2002 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, Colorado on 2 February 2002. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Tom Meade's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-co], DeckTech (Tom "Divebum101" Meade, 6 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
